rules.rule:
Switchyard host/runtime boundary. Apply every check below, on top of the built-in language rule:
- Verification, approval, and publication or landing are Host operations.
- The agent runtime gets no workflow tools. It must not gain open-PR, run-verify, approve, or land tools. It only edits files and runs commands through the Rust ExecutionEnv.
- Uncertainty about effects stays a Host fact and is never resolved by the adapter.
- Fail closed on unknown methods, stale bindings, or missing facts.
- FakeRuntime stays the default. Nothing in the change may enable Pi or a live provider.
